annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros, Perú
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves the Regulation of Law 31814 (6 titles, 36 articles, 6 final provisions).
The Secretariat of Government and Digital Transformation (SGTD) of PCM is the lead technical-normative authority for AI.
Creates a controlled experimentation environment (sandbox) for AI, with support for MSMEs and startups.
PCM must approve a National AI Strategy (ENIA) and a National Data Governance Strategy within one year.
Public entities must use NTP-ISO/IEC 27002 and NTP-ISO 31000 for security, privacy and risk management.
annotation.summary_en: Peruvian Supreme Decree 115-2025-PCM approves the regulation implementing Law 31814 on promoting AI for economic and social development. It designates the digital transformation secretariat as AI authority, sets up a regulatory sandbox, supports MSMEs, mandates a national AI strategy, and requires use of security and risk-management technical standards.
annotation.title_clean: Decreto Supremo N° 115-2025-PCM, que aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley N° 31814, Ley que promueve el uso de la inteligencia artificial en favor del desarrollo económico y social del país
annotation.title_en: Supreme Decree No. 115-2025-PCM approving the Regulation of Law No. 31814 promoting the use of artificial intelligence for the country's economic and social development
